yt_title: Light Speed Isn't a Speed Limit — It's a One-Way Door
short:
Chase a beam of light at half light speed.
It still runs away at exactly the same speed.

Fly to Andromeda — you age 28 years.
Earth ages 2,500,000.

Light speed was never a speed limit.
It's a one-way door into the future.
cta:
